exercises.question: By next December, I _____ for this organization for exactly a decade.
exercises.explanation: The future perfect continuous is used to emphasize the duration of an action up to a specific point in the future. ('Will have worked' is also grammatically possible, but continuous is preferred for ongoing employment duration).

exercises.question: By next June, I ________ at this company for ten years.
exercises.explanation: Future perfect continuous = will have been + -ing. It emphasizes duration up to a future time.
